This looks great — you've picked up everything I asked for. Pasting a link and having the title, description, and icon filled in for me (with sensible fallbacks when a page doesn't cooperate), the smarter search with tags, and/or/not, exact phrases and grouping, the tag suggestions so I stop making near-duplicates, and keeping "still need to read" separate from favorites with its own view — that's exactly how I picture using it.

One small thing I noticed and actually like: opening a link doesn't mark it read on its own, only when I say so. That's the behavior I'd want, so please keep it.

I'm happy with this version of the spec. Go ahead and put together the implementation plan — I'll wait to see that before anything gets built.
